premise.claim: With this PR, a Helm install upgraded beyond the gate slice gets the same admission behavior as the kubectl-rendered manifests — previously the chart shipped the pre-gate webhook configuration.
premise.evidence: base 73e05db4: 0 v1alpha1-deprecation entries in the chart template vs 6 in config/webhook/manifests.yaml — results/premise-and-static-evidence.txt

findings.note: RED on head is the reproduction: the chart default image v0.9.0-d88b3186 registers none of the six v1alpha1 deprecation paths the chart renders. Flips GREEN when the default image tag is bumped to a post-#524 commit (verified with tag v0.9.0-a1ff903e).

witness.note: Mechanism witness (canary-like, stays green by design): pre-#524 handler set + chart-rendered webhook configs => API server rejects v1alpha1 RBG/RBGSet writes with 'failed calling webhook ... the server could not find the requested resource'; Ignore-policy kinds still succeed.

findings.note: The guard the PR is missing: chart webhook specs must equal config/webhook/manifests.yaml. Passes on head (parity holds); bites when the template drifts. These are uplift candidates for the author's fix.
